title: AgentCoop provider product
description: One product of the provider API (apps/provider-api/products/<id>.json). Validated at load time by parseProduct (src/products.ts); a runner (src/runners.ts) serves its jobs.

id.description: Product id, also the file name

label.description: Shown in the catalog and pool labels

unit.description: What one credit is, e.g. GPU-hour, GB

minutesPerCredit.description: GPU products: GPU minutes per credit (gpu-h100: 60)

unitsPerCredit.description: Any product: metered units per credit (data-proxy: 1024 MB); overrides minutesPerCredit

tokenId.description: BSV-21 credit token id; null until provider-cli mint

minutesPerSecond.description: GPU: simulated minutes per real second

unitsPerSecond.description: Any runner: simulated units per real second
